design.engine: pinned deterministic-v6 JAR; zero gameplay overlays

confidence.note: Conservative t critical (2.5 exceeds the two-sided Bonferroni 95% familywise critical for 24 panels and two comparisons).

design.limitation: Fresh seeds and panel shuffles; same fixed 75 published 2025 online-stage teams and four Zombies. Does not measure unseen opponents or the official final roster.

randomness.provenance: One crypto-random draw before execution; 24 independent panel salts and 48 seed suffixes; no redraw based on outcomes.
